name: Generic Analytics Pack
description: Industry-agnostic fallback pack for tabular data that doesn't clearly match a specialized industry pack. Deliberately low-confidence by design — see forge_core.classification.matcher — so it never outranks a genuine industry match, but always provides a usable baseline.

vocabulary.definition: One row in the primary table being analyzed

canonical_roles.measure_amount: a primary numeric measure worth aggregating
canonical_roles.category_dim: a primary categorical dimension worth grouping by
canonical_roles.date_dim: a primary date dimension worth trending by

notes: No industry-specific vocabulary is assumed — treat all categorical values literally
All data access must be read-only
